name: Solve Intelligence
long_description:
Solve Intelligence is the AI platform for helping legal professionals with every part of the patent process.

With $55M backing from Y Combinator, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, 20VC, Operator Collective, Visionaries, and others, they have assembled a world-leading team of patent attorneys, AI PhDs, and software developers to build products for patent application drafting, office action responses, invention harvesting, claim charting, infringement analysis, FTO, validity challenges, patent litigation, and more.

They are now selling their 100% secure and confidential software to 700+ IP firms and in-house teams across the US, Europe, and Asia (e.g. DLA Piper, Siemens, Perkins Coie, Amgen - see customers https://www.solveintelligence.com/#customers).

Solve customers are reporting 60-90% efficiency and quality improvements (see testimonials https://www.solveintelligence.com/#testimonials).

See a demo today: https://www.solveintelligence.com/contact-us
one_liner: AI patent drafting, prosecution, litigation and more for legal teams.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Chris did his PhD in machine learning at UCL, publishing and winning awards in top AI conferences and journals. He holds an MRes from the University of Cambridge and an MEng from Imperial College London. Prior to founding Solve Intelligence, Chris worked at leading tech organisations, including The Alan Turing Institute, InstaDeep, and Dyson.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Sanj completed his PhD in machine learning at UCL, won awards at top AI conferences, and developed popular open-source code for fine-tuning large language models. Before founding Solve Intelligence, he worked at Magic Carpet AI and Huawei Technologies. He holds an MSci in Physics from the University of Cambridge.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Angus completed his MEng degree in computer science at the University of Bristol, during which he received a cyber security scholarship from GCHQ. He has since worked as a Quantitative Developer at Coremont LLP, a spin-off from hedge fund Brevan Howard.

launches.title: 💡 Solve Intelligence - Write patents with AI
launches.tagline: Reduce the cost and time to write patents.
launches.body:
**Tl;dr:** At [Solve Intelligence](https://www.solveintelligence.com/?utm_source=YC+Launch&utm_medium=Main&utm_campaign=Launch&utm_id=SolveIntelligence) we use AI to help you write high-quality patents quickly. We do this by providing a simple in-browser document editor that any patent attorney or inventor can start using straight away. [Connect with us today](https://www.solveintelligence.com/contact?utm_source=YC+Launch&utm_medium=Contact&utm_campaign=Launch&utm_id=SolveIntelligence).

---

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72326&key=user_uploads/1367673/ba232c74-2217-4a90-b551-4137904874ed)

From left to right: [Solve Intelligence](https://www.solveintelligence.com/?utm_source=YC+Launch&utm_medium=Main&utm_campaign=Launch&utm_id=SolveIntelligence) co-founders [Angus](https://www.linkedin.com/in/angus-parsonson-24935914b/), [Sanj](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sanj-ahilan-844b33137/), and [Chris](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chris-parsonson-381830a3/) (Angus’ brother) in San Francisco.

---

### **What are we building?**

We are building an in-browser document editor powered by AI to help inventors and attorneys write patents. Our product can help with all stages of the patent life cycle, from drafting and filing to prosecution and opposition. For further details on what our product offers, refer to [this analysis on the top 5 AI tools for patents.](https://www.solveintelligence.com/blog-posts/top-patent-analysis-tools)

### **Product Snapshot**

Given your tech and prior art, use AI to draft a patent:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72326&key=user_uploads/1367673/f221a3d5-21ff-4171-88e3-01301a84b9a7)

Chat with the AI and use it to help edit the patent:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72326&key=user_uploads/1367673/6707811a-c00a-4eb9-a729-94827e8bfefa)

### **Why are we building it?**

From drafting to grant, a worldwide patent costs $60K on average and can take years to obtain. If the patent is contentious, then costs can get much higher ($100K-1M+). It's a slow, complicated, and expensive process which can block innovation and delay time-to-market.

There's a need for software solutions which can make the patenting process more efficient.

Most existing intellectual property software focuses on _search_ (finding related technology). However, the _generative_ steps of drafting a patent and responding to examiners and competitors make up 90%+ of the costs.

Enter AI, which now has the ability to help with generative patent tasks. At Solve Intelligence, we have assembled a world-class team of AI researchers and software developers. Our goal? To leverage and build on recent AI breakthroughs to transform the patenting process.

### **Who are we building for?**

Our product is for any tech company or inventor striving for swift, high-quality patents at below-market rates. It’s also a valuable tool for patent law firms looking to increase their bandwidth, engage more personally with their clients, and ensure that the patents they file are of high quality. For further details on how our product can help with patent drafting, refer to [this analysis of the top 6 patent drafting tools](https://www.solveintelligence.com/blog-posts/best-ai-patent-drafting-tools).

### **Our ask**

[Contact us](https://www.solveintelligence.com/contact-us) to:

* **book a full demo** and **give us your feedback**
* connect us to **patent attorneys** in your network
* connect us to **tech inventors** in your network
